title: French Beef Bourguignon
description: Hearty French stew made with tender beef and rich flavors.
instructions: Season beef with salt and pepper.
Heat oil in a large Dutch oven over medium-high heat. Sear beef until browned, about 5 minutes. Remove beef and set aside.
Add more oil if necessary, then sauté onions until softened, about 5 minutes.
Add garlic and cook for 1 minute.
Add flour and cook for 1 minute.
Add red wine, beef broth, bay leaf, and browned beef. Bring to a boil, then reduce heat to low and simmer for 2-3 hours, or until beef is tender.
Add carrots and potatoes. Simmer for another 30 minutes, or until they are tender.
Season with salt and pepper to taste.
Serve hot, garnished with fresh parsley if desired.
